svg.title: Five new ways to feel at home.
svg.desc: Actual Sysvia dashboard captures cycle through Sage, Sky, Graphite, Forest and Dusk, showing the same sample workspace in each theme. Dark and Light remain available. Reduced motion shows Sage.
